$note: Named caption treatments for body slides. A treatment is a combination of colour role, weight, size step, emphasis style and anchor/container — the whole visual register of a slide's caption stack, chosen once per deck and applied to every body slide in it. Rotated no-repeat-within-N by pipeline/render/lib/history.js, the same way cutouts.json is rotated. Brand-scoped because every value here names a token role from 01-tokens/tokens.json: this file never carries a hex value or a font name, only role names the renderer resolves through the token layer. Pixel geometry (band padding, rule gaps, side-label column) lives in pipeline/render/component-metrics.json under `caption`.

$roles.ground: slideShell ground: white | accent. accent is Vector Navy; it is the ground the cta already uses, so it needs no new token.
$roles.anchor: where the caption stack sits in the content area: top | centre | bottom
$roles.layout: stack (kicker above headline) | side-label (kicker in a left column)
$roles.headline.stepShift: steps to move along the token size scale from the step the component asks for. Negative is smaller. Positive shifts are NOT used yet: component-capacity.json budgets were measured at the component's own step, so growing a headline needs capacity.js re-run first or the copy budget is a guess about a different size.
$roles.emphasis: how [[bracketed]] phrases render: colour | weight | chip | underline | signal. Always exactly one [data-accent] element, whatever the style, so the qa accent-count rule is unaffected.
$roles.container: none | band (solid kicker band) | tint (ground-alt block behind the stack) | rules (hairlines above and below the headline)

treatments.note: The current look, kept in the rotation as the calm end of the range. Reproduces pre-treatment output exactly.
Kicker inverted into a solid ink band, stack pushed to the top of the safe area. The headline carries the weight instead of a colour shift.

The whole slide on Vector Navy. The strongest register in the set, and the only one that breaks a run of white slides. Emphasis is signal ink, the one place on a body slide signal is allowed: 12:1 on this ground, and phrase-scoped so it stays a pop rather than a second brand colour.
Stack sits in a ground-alt block, anchored to the bottom of the safe area. Emphasised phrases become solid ink chips.
Hairlines above and below the headline, borrowed from the cover's type-led hairline-stack device. Mono kicker in accent ink, top anchored.
Kicker moves out of the stack into a left-hand mono column, so the caption reads across rather than down. The headline drops one step because the column is narrower.
